text: Integrated circuit engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates electronic science and technology, microelectronics, materials science and computer science, focusing on the design, manufacture, testing and application of integrated circuits (chips). Its training objective is:Master the full-process technology of integrated circuits (design → tape-out → packaging and testing), and possess the ability to solve complex engineering problems in chip design and manufacturing;Cultivate high-end talents serving the national "independent and controllable chip" strategy, who can engage in technological research and development, engineering management and innovative application work in the semiconductor industry chain (design, manufacturing, packaging, equipment, materials).
